principles: CI validates the current contract, not every historical contract.
When a new test fully supersedes an old test, delete the old active test after the replacement passes.
History belongs in Git, changelog, registries and certification evidence, not in permanently active duplicate tests.
Every new behavior change must add or update the smallest effective test surface.
Do not add broad regression suites for localized changes unless a broader invariant was actually changed.
A test that no longer maps to a current invariant is stale and should be removed.
Certification tests must reference the current source/runtime baseline only.
Historical certification artifacts may remain as evidence files but must not run in current CI unless explicitly reactivated.
PASS requires real execution; deleted historical tests do not erase historical evidence.

test_classes.CURRENT_CONTRACT: Active. Validates a present invariant or current baseline.
test_classes.CHANGE_FOCUSED: Active while validating a change; may become CURRENT_CONTRACT.
test_classes.REGRESSION_GUARD: Active only when a bug/invariant remains plausibly reusable.
test_classes.HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: Not active in CI. Preserved as registry/docs/git evidence.
test_classes.SUPERSEDED: Must not remain in active CI.

keep_active_if: is the only effective oracle for a current contract
remove_active_if: replacement test covers the same invariant more accurately
duplicates another active test without differential risk
